# v3.0 Overworld Art Audit and Prefab Catalog

## Goal

Stop random prefab guessing and create a curated overworld art catalog that can be reviewed before the generator uses it.

## Added

- `Assets/LegendOfZed/Scripts/Overworld/ZedOverworldArtCatalog.cs`
- `Assets/LegendOfZed/Editor/ZedV30OverworldArtAuditAndCatalogSetup.cs`
- `Assets/LegendOfZed/ReadMeDocs/Zed_v3.0_OverworldArtAuditAndPrefabCatalog.md`

## Generated by the setup

- `Assets/LegendOfZed/Overworld/ArtCatalog/ZedOverworldArtCatalog.asset`
- `Assets/LegendOfZed/ReadMeDocs/Zed_v3.0_OverworldArtCatalog_AuditReport.md`

## Menus

Build or refresh the catalog:

`Legend of Zed/Setup/Overworld/v3.0 Build Overworld Art Catalog`

Select the catalog asset:

`Legend of Zed/Setup/Overworld/v3.0 Select Overworld Art Catalog`

Validate useful categories:

`Legend of Zed/Setup/Overworld/v3.0 Validate Overworld Art Catalog`

## Categories

The catalog separates:

- roads
- intersections
- sidewalks
- buildings
- special buildings
- doors / entrances
- signs
- grass / park ground
- paths
- trees
- bushes
- benches
- vehicles
- police vehicles
- street lights
- traffic lights
- hydrants
- mailboxes
- parking meters
- power boxes
- trash cans
- dumpsters / skips
- trash heaps
- paper debris
- barriers
- fences
- generic props

## Important

This pass only scans and catalogs prefabs.

It does not alter:

- generator placement
- seeded layout
- player
- zombies
- weapon pickups
- ammo IDs
- portals
- NavMesh
- combat systems

## Recommended next step

After reviewing the generated catalog:

`v3.1 wire generator to curated road/sidewalk catalog`
